title: Foreskin Tissue DNA Extraction
author: Brandon Maust
materials: Weigh tube and calculate net tissue weight.

steps.title: Add bead and buffer
steps.instruction: Place a steel bead into a 1.5 mL tube and add 800 µL of CD1 solution.

substeps.instruction: Add steel bead to 1.5 mL tube
Add 800 µL CD1 to tube

steps.title: Add tissue sample
steps.instruction: Dissect ~25 mg (≈3 mm) of foreskin tissue and place it into the tube containing the bead and CD1.

substeps.instruction: Dissect approximately 25 mg (3 mm piece) of tissue with a scalpel
Add tissue to the tube with bead and CD1

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Lyse tissue on TissueLyzer II for 2 min at 30 Hz, rotate block 180°, and repeat.

substeps.instruction: Process tubes on TissueLyzer II for 2 min at 30 Hz
Rotate block 180° and repeat

steps.title: Collapse foam
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge tubes to collapse any foam.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes briefly to collapse foam

steps.title: Transfer lysate to plate
steps.instruction: Settle beads in PowerBead Pro plate, then transfer each tube’s contents (excluding the steel bead) into individual wells.

substeps.instruction: Spin PowerBead Pro plate to settle beads at the bottom
Add contents of each specimen tube (except steel bead) to a PowerBead plate well

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K to each well, seal, and vortex briefly.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K to each well
Seal plate with film
Vortex briefly to mix

steps.title: Incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate sealed plate at 65 °C for 60 min or until tissue is mostly digested.

substeps.instruction: Incubate plate at 65 °C for 60 min or until tissue is mostly digested

steps.title: Second homogenization
steps.instruction: Process plate on TissueLyser II for 5 min at 25 Hz, rotate 180°, and repeat.

substeps.instruction: Process plate on TissueLyser II for 5 min at 25 Hz
Rotate plate 180° and repeat

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge plate at 3000 × g for 7.5 min.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate at 3000 x g for 7.5 min

steps.title: Transfer first supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a well‑vator, transfer ~350 µL supernatant from each well to a fresh S‑block.

substeps.instruction: Transfer approximately 350 µL supernatant from each well to fresh S‑block using well‑vator

steps.title: Add CD2 and mix
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL CD2 to each well and mix thoroughly by pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of solution CD2 to each well
Mix thoroughly by pipetting

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Seal plate with film and centrifuge at 3000 × g for 7.5 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Seal the plate with film
Centrifuge at 3000 x g for 7.5 min at room temperature

steps.title: Transfer second supernatant
steps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer 500 µL supernatant to a fresh S‑block using the well‑vator.

substeps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer 500 µL of supernatant to fresh S‑block using well‑vator

steps.title: DNA purification on QIAcube
steps.instruction: Run the DNeasy 96 PowerSoil Pro protocol on QIAcube HT (from page 17 onward), eluting DNA in 120 µL and performing a vacuum performance check.

substeps.instruction: Follow DNeasy 96 PowerSoil Pro Protocol for QIAcube HT (page 17 onward)
Elute in maximum volume (120 µL)
Include vacuum performance check

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Seal the plate and store at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Seal plate and freeze at -20°C
